policy.attribution: Always display the publisher and link to the original article.
policy.paid_access: Public feed metadata may be indexed, but MISE never bypasses a login or paywall. Full licensed access requires a publisher agreement.
policy.corroboration: Supplier, association, official, social, and community sources retain their source class and do not count as independent corroboration of their own claims.
policy.notes: Active means the feed endpoint was reachable and returned XML during the 2026-07-21 audit. It does not imply permission to reproduce full articles or images.
